FINAL SQL:
SELECT t.transcript_date, t.transcript_id
FROM Transcripts t
LEFT JOIN Transcript_Contents tc ON t.transcript_id = tc.transcript_id
GROUP BY t.transcript_id, t.transcript_date
HAVING COUNT(tc.student_course_id) = (
    SELECT MIN(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM Transcript_Contents
        GROUP BY transcript_id
    )
);
